title: 한의원에서: 침을 맞은 적이 있어요?
objective: Use -은/ㄴ 적이 있다/없다 to talk about past experience, and understand 엎드리세요.
summary: A first visit to a Korean medicine clinic for back pain.
setting: A foreign resident goes to a neighbourhood Korean medicine clinic (한의원) for the first time because of back pain.

task.title: Talk about clinic experiences
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to complete each item.

words.exampleMeaning: A Korean medicine clinic opened near my home.
I got acupuncture on my shoulder.
My back feels warm after the hot pack.
I sprained my ankle on the stairs.
My neck hurts when I read lying on my stomach.

words.meaning: have / have never done (before). Use -은 after a consonant (먹은) and -ㄴ after a vowel (간). For stems ending in ㄹ, drop ㄹ and add -ㄴ (살다 → 산, 만들다 → 만든).
words.example: 저는 한국에서 병원에 간 적이 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I have been to a hospital in Korea.

dialogue.meaning: How can I help you? (What brings you here?)
I came because my lower back hurts. It's my first time at a Korean medicine clinic.
Have you ever had acupuncture before?

dialogue.korean: 아니요, 맞은 적이 없어요. 좀 무서워요.
dialogue.meaning: No, I've never had it. I'm a little scared.

dialogue.korean: 괜찮아요. 많이 아프지 않아요. 침을 맞은 다음에 찜질도 할 거예요.
dialogue.meaning: It's okay. It doesn't hurt much. After the acupuncture, we'll also put a hot pack on it.

dialogue.korean: 한약도 먹어야 돼요? 전에 한약을 먹은 적이 있는데 너무 썼어요.
dialogue.meaning: Do I have to take herbal medicine too? I've taken it before, and it was too bitter.

dialogue.korean: 오늘은 침만 맞아 보세요. 여기 침대에 엎드리세요.
dialogue.meaning: Today, just try the acupuncture. Please lie face down on this bed.

exercises: Change the verb in brackets to -은/ㄴ 적이 있어요: ① 인삼차를 (마시다) ____. ② 발목을 (삐다) ____. ③ 어깨에 찜질을 (받다) ____.
Answer 'No' using -은 적이 없어요: 한국 병원에서 주사를 맞은 적이 있어요? → 아니요, ____.
Read the dialogue again. Which sentence is true? ⓐ 환자는 전에 침을 맞은 적이 있어요. ⓑ 환자는 전에 한약을 먹은 적이 있어요. ⓒ 오늘 환자는 한약만 먹어요.
The doctor says this. What should you do? 이쪽 침대에 엎드리세요. ⓐ lie on your back ⓑ lie face down ⓒ sit on the bed
answers: ① 마신 적이 있어요 ② 삔 적이 있어요 ③ 받은 적이 있어요
맞은 적이 없어요 (주사를 맞은 적이 없어요)
